title: 激光切割机4：设计软件

author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/04_Laser Cutter 4 xTool Studio/src.py

points.K1: 设计都在设计软件里完成
points.K2: 在家也能下载、提前设计
points.K4: 最近文件：别动别人的设计
points.K6: 我的空间：人人可见，用完删除
points.K14: 公共账号只用免费设计

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在创客空间的电脑前，屏幕上是空白的设计画布，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits at a computer in a makerspace, the monitor showing a blank design canvas, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识激光切割机的设计软件。
overlay: 激光设计软件入门与加工前检查

shots.scene: 电脑、文件夹、上传箭头、放大镜四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a computer monitor, a folder, an upload arrow and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 账号、文件、找设计，一样样来。

shots.scene: 阿杰在家里的书桌前想着耳环的样子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at his desk at home, imagining a pair of cute wooden cat earrings shown in a thought bubble.
shots.narration: 阿杰想做一对猫咪耳环。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，看着空白的笔记本屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head while looking at a blank laptop screen.
shots.narration: 设计在哪做？做好了怎么带过去？

shots.scene: 小研在创客空间的电脑前招呼他过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits at a makerspace computer and waves him over.
shots.narration: 小研说：先认识一下设计软件。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从主页开始，一页一页看。

shots.section_title: 设计都在设计软件里完成
shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上空白画布和工具栏图标
shots.prompt_en: A computer monitor showing a blank design canvas with a toolbar of simple icons. No people.
shots.narration: 激光设计，都在设计软件里完成。
overlay: 设计都在设计软件里完成

shots.section_title: 在家也能下载、提前设计
shots.scene: 阿杰在家里的书桌前用笔记本电脑画设计
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk at home sketching a design on his laptop.
shots.narration: 软件可以装在自己电脑上提前设计。
overlay: 在家也能下载、提前设计

shots.section_title: 在家也能下载、提前设计
shots.scene: 笔记本屏幕上的空白登录框和个人头像图标
shots.prompt_en: A laptop screen with a blank login box and a personal avatar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 在家使用，要注册个人账号。

shots.scene: 场所电脑屏幕上的公共账号头像图标打勾，个人头像被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A makerspace computer screen with a shared group avatar icon with a green check and a personal avatar icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 在场所电脑上，只用场所的公共账号。

shots.section_title: 最近文件：别动别人的设计
shots.scene: 主页上一排空白线稿缩略图
shots.prompt_en: A software home page with a row of blank line-drawing thumbnails under a recent files area. No people.
shots.narration: 主页的最近文件，也有别人的设计。
overlay: 最近文件：别动别人的设计

shots.section_title: 最近文件：别动别人的设计
shots.scene: 打开并修改他人文件的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand editing someone else's design file with a pencil, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 请尊重别人，不要打开修改。

shots.scene: 主页下方一排成品照片缩略图，带分享图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of thumbnails of finished wooden crafts with share icons. No people.
shots.narration: 下方推荐的设计，本就是分享的，可以用。

shots.section_title: 我的空间：人人可见，用完删除
shots.scene: 左侧菜单中一个文件夹图标被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A software side menu with a folder icon highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 我的空间里，是公共账号保存的设计。
overlay: 我的空间：人人可见，用完删除

shots.section_title: 我的空间：人人可见，用完删除
shots.scene: 文件缩略图旁有几个眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: A design thumbnail surrounded by several small eye icons. No people.
shots.narration: 存在这里，所有用户都看得见。

shots.section_title: 我的空间：人人可见，用完删除
shots.scene: 三点菜单展开，删除项被选中
shots.prompt_en: A blank three-dot menu opened on a design thumbnail, with a trash bin item highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 做完不想公开，就点菜单删除。

shots.scene: 下载箭头图标把文件存进U盘
shots.prompt_en: A download arrow icon moving a design file into a USB flash drive. No people.
shots.narration: 在家做好的设计，用下载保存文件。

shots.scene: U盘、邮件、云盘三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a USB flash drive, an email envelope and a cloud folder. No people.
shots.narration: 存U盘、发邮件或放网盘，带过来。

shots.scene: 阿杰把U盘插进场所电脑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student plugs a USB flash drive into a makerspace computer.
shots.narration: 在场所电脑上插入U盘或取回文件，

shots.scene: 上传按钮被点击，文件出现在列表首位
shots.prompt_en: A cursor clicks an upload button and a new design file appears first in a list of blank thumbnails. No people.
shots.narration: 点上传，选中文件，就导入了。

shots.scene: 列表里两个相同的缩略图，其中一个被拖进垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: Two identical design thumbnails in a list; one is dragged into a trash bin icon. No people.
shots.narration: 多出来的重复副本，可以删掉。

shots.scene: 文件图标里带着一个小齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: A design file icon with a small gear icon attached to it. No people.
shots.narration: 导入的文件会保留切割设置。

shots.scene: 探索页上满屏成品照片，搜索框里一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A software explore page full of thumbnails of finished crafts, with a magnifying glass in a search box. No people.
shots.narration: 探索页里，有大量别人分享的设计。

shots.scene: 搜索结果：咖啡杯垫、恐龙模型、桌面收纳盒
shots.prompt_en: Search results showing thumbnails of a coffee coaster, a wooden dinosaur model and a desk organizer box. No people.
shots.narration: 可以随便看看，也可以搜索关键词。

shots.scene: 设计详情页：大预览图，旁边材料、作者、机型图标
shots.prompt_en: A design detail window with a large preview of a cat earring and icons for material, author and machine beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 点开设计，能看到材料、预览和作者。

shots.scene: 机型列表里没有本机，出现转换箭头和尺子图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank machine list without a matching machine icon, next to a conversion arrow and a ruler icon. No people.
shots.narration: 列表里没有本机，不代表不能用。

shots.scene: 尺子和文件转换箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A ruler icon and a file conversion arrow icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 只是尺寸和文件，可能要多转换。

shots.scene: 紫色光束和红外光束两个激光头图标，中间问号
shots.prompt_en: Two laser head icons, one with a violet beam and one with an invisible infrared beam drawn as a dotted line, with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外激光的设计，移到本机可能有困难。

shots.scene: 两种外观相近的木板并排
shots.prompt_en: Two similar-looking light wooden sheets side by side with an equals sign. No people.
shots.narration: 材料不必一样，想效果像就选相近的。

shots.scene: 画布上一排猫咪耳环图形，设备连接图标亮绿灯
shots.prompt_en: A design canvas with a row of cat earring shapes and a machine connection icon glowing green. No people.
shots.narration: 打开到画布，公共账号会连着设备。

shots.scene: 设备连接图标灰着，旁边一个暂停的小钟
shots.prompt_en: A machine connection icon shown grey and offline, with a small clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 演示时设备没连上，平时会显示已连接。

shots.scene: 鼠标拖动整组图形，再单独拖动一个
shots.prompt_en: A cursor drags the whole group of shapes, then drags one single shape to rotate it. No people.
shots.narration: 可以整体移动，也可以单独调整。

shots.section_title: 公共账号只用免费设计
shots.scene: 缩略图角上有价格标记的设计图标
shots.prompt_en: Design thumbnails, one with a small price tag icon in its corner. No people.
shots.narration: 不是所有设计都免费。
overlay: 公共账号只用免费设计

shots.section_title: 公共账号只用免费设计
shots.scene: 公共账号头像旁价格标记被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A shared group avatar icon next to a price tag icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 公共账号上，只用免费设计。

shots.section_title: 公共账号只用免费设计
shots.scene: 阿杰用自己的手机购买，文件存进U盘
shots.prompt_en: The young male student uses his own phone with a personal account, then a design file moves into a USB flash drive.
shots.narration: 付费设计在自己设备上买好再带来。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开下一张课程卡，上面是铅笔和画布图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips to the next blank lesson card showing a pencil and canvas icon.
shots.narration: 编辑设计和画布工具，下一课再讲。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现公共账号头像和文件夹图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a shared group avatar and a folder.
shots.narration: 公共电脑用公共账号，别动他人文件。

shots.scene: 下载箭头、U盘、上传箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a download arrow, a USB flash drive and an upload arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 在家下载，带来上传，设置都保留。

shots.scene: 探索页、详情页、价格标记打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an explore page, a design detail window and a price tag crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 探索页找设计，公共账号只用免费的。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰举着做好的猫咪木耳环向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student hold up finished wooden cat earrings and wave goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 下一课，动手编辑耳环设计，再见！
